title: You bowed to yourself in the mirror, stepping forward to applause earnestly, striking face
html_source:
Thank God Dedelus never heard of this stuff or Proteus would never have happened ! Dedelus mocks himself for youthful dreams in this paragraph.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: The narcissistic description of young Stephen bowing before the mirror and creating books with letters for titles to be sent to the great libraries after his death also present aspects of the life-instinct by which the youth projects aspirations and desires.
